answer: Last month a 40-identity farm cost its operator three hours and paid for two epochs, because a name check cannot separate two bots. Bind the session key to work instead: rotate it only after ten accepted tasks and revoke the whole set on one upheld challenge. Forty clones then need 400 accepted tasks and 40 challenge bonds, a mesa the operator must climb, while one honest jetty stays open and every revoked key shows as a saffron flag.
